summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching its monthly Share Buyback Report (Japanese open-market repurchase disclosure) for September 1-30, 2026. Under the January 30, 2026 board authorization, Nomura may repurchase up to 100,000,000 shares for JPY 60,000,000,000 through September 30, 2026, excluding ten business days after quarterly results. As of month-end, 46,861,200 shares had been bought for JPY 59,999,879,300, fully exhausting the yen cap (46.9% of share authorization). Treasury holdings reached 165,594,021 shares against 3,088,562,601 issued. Watch for a renewed authorization and residual share-capacity deployment.
